blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos III is backing bills to address gun safety, children’s online protection, and political dynasties, according to a statement his office issued on Tuesday. He has co-authored measures with House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III, including proposals that seek to strengthen firearm regulations and protect minors on social media. One is House Bill No. 11387, or the proposed Responsible Firearm Ownership and Safe Storage Act, filed following the shooting at Banga National High School in South Cotabato in September, where the shooter was able to use his father’s gun.
